title: Onion Powder Price Per Kg: A B2B Purchasing Guide for Importers and Food Brands
content_html:
For importers, distributors and food brands, the most accurate onion powder price per kg comes from a complete product specification, not from a generic online listing. Grade, onion variety, moisture, particle size, packaging, order quantity, destination and shipping terms can all change the final landed cost.

Tradenest Naturals supplies dehydrated onion powder to food manufacturers, wholesalers, exporters, restaurants, snack companies, instant food brands and private label businesses. This guide explains what to specify when you compare a wholesale onion powder offer, and how to request a quotation you can assess on both commercial and technical terms.

Onion Powder Exporter: Direct answer on what you receive and who should buy it

Bulk onion powder is a finely milled, dehydrated onion ingredient supplied in an agreed grade, mesh size, pack format and export specification for commercial food production. It suits buyers who need consistent onion flavour without the labour, waste and short shelf life of fresh onions.

A commercial supply programme may include:

  • Dehydrated onion powder made from selected onion raw material.
  • Standard or customer-specific particle sizes, including onion powder 80 mesh.
  • Moisture-resistant, food-grade packaging for domestic or international transport.
  • Batch number, manufacturing date, best-before date, net weight and storage guidance on each pack.
  • A product specification sheet agreed before production.
  • Bulk, wholesale, private label or OEM packing options.

Typical users include seasoning manufacturers, instant noodle and soup producers, snack and namkeen companies, sauce and dip brands, bakeries, ready-to-cook manufacturers, QSR chains, cloud kitchens and ingredient distributors. A distributor may buy standard bulk packs. A retail or FMCG brand may need printed packaging, a defined mesh and a more detailed approval process.

Product specifications that affect the quotation

Finalise the product specification before you compare prices, because two products both called onion powder can differ in performance and production cost.

Grade and raw material

Ask whether the powder is made from a defined onion variety and whether it contains any carrier or anti-caking agent. Also state the use: seasoning, soup, sauces, snacks, bakery or another application. A natural onion powder specification usually covers appearance, aroma, flavour, foreign matter, moisture and microbiological limits.

If you need a clean-label ingredient, state clearly that no carrier, added colour or other processing aid is allowed unless declared and approved. A standard grade may be enough for seasoning blends. Infant, nutraceutical or other highly regulated uses may need extra controls and documents.

Particle size and mesh

Mesh affects dispersion, mouthfeel, blending, dusting and processing speed. Onion powder 80 mesh is a fine option for even seasoning blends, instant foods, soups, sauces and uses where fast hydration helps. Coarser grades may be better when you want a stronger visual onion character or slower flavour release.

Specify the target mesh, the sieve tolerance and how sieving should be controlled. If the powder will run through automated dosing or a high-speed blender, share the equipment details. The manufacturer can then suggest a practical grade.

Other technical details to confirm

  • Moisture limit and water activity, where relevant.
  • Colour, aroma strength and flavour profile.
  • Microbiological limits, including total plate count, yeast and mould, and pathogens, as required in your market.
  • Allergen, GMO, irradiation, pesticide residue and heavy metal requirements where relevant.
  • Storage conditions and expected shelf life.
  • Which test reports you need, such as a certificate of analysis, and how batches should be sampled.

MOQ, packaging, and lead time

MOQ and lead time depend on stock, order volume, packaging format and level of customisation (the MOQ itself is 5 Kg per product); standard bulk onion powder usually moves faster than private label production.

Minimum order quantity

At Tradenest Naturals, the MOQ is 5 Kg per product. A custom mesh, printed pouch, retail label or OEM programme needs more planning, because materials and production runs must be arranged in advance. These details are confirmed with the quotation.

When you request the onion powder bulk price, share your trial quantity, monthly need and annual forecast. This lets the supplier separate a sample or trial quote from a contract price that can scale. Larger repeat orders can lower the unit cost and support steady raw material planning.

Packaging options

Formats can include 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg bags, bulk bags, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers and custom printed export packaging. The inner liner should be food-grade and moisture resistant. The outer pack should handle stacking, handling and international transport.

Confirm whether the price includes inner liners, cartons, pallets, labels, desiccants if needed, and export marking. Each commercial pack should carry the batch number, manufacturing date, best-before date, net weight, storage instructions and any required regulatory information.

Lead time

Lead time is confirmed after the specification, packaging artwork, order quantity, payment terms and shipping plan are approved. Standard material in stock can ship sooner. Fresh production, special sieving, private label packing or third-party lab testing may add time. Ask for separate dates for artwork approval, production, dispatch and estimated transit.

Certifications and quality assurance

A dependable onion powder manufacturer should show batch consistency, traceability, food safety controls and documents that suit the destination market.

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. Our process covers raw material selection, cleaning, dehydration, milling, sieving, inspection against the agreed specification, and packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Buyers should request the documents their market and application need, rather than assume every document applies to every product or shipment.

Documents that importers commonly ask for include:

  • Product specification sheet.
  • Batch details and packing list.
  • Commercial invoice and shipping documents.
  • Certificate of origin or other documents your importer or broker requests.
  • Phytosanitary, fumigation or other documents where the destination requires them.
  • Independent test reports for allergens, pesticides, heavy metals or microbiology, where your market or customer needs them.

Before you order, share the importing country, HS code guidance from your customs broker, local labelling rules and any customer approval checklist. Tradenest Naturals provides export documentation support and reviews these requirements before production, so the product, label, documents and packaging match the order.

Applications and formulation value

Onion powder provides repeatable onion flavour, easy dosing and longer storage than fresh onion in dry and semi-liquid foods.

  • Seasonings: snack coatings, popcorn, fries, barbecue blends, pizza seasoning, peri peri and instant noodle masala.
  • Soups and sauces: dry soup premixes, gravies, dips, marinades and ready-to-cook bases.
  • Bakery and savoury foods: crackers, savoury biscuits, breads, fillings and prepared doughs.
  • Processed foods: meat alternatives, frozen foods, meal kits, convenience foods and institutional recipes.
  • Foodservice: restaurants, hotels, QSR kitchens and cloud kitchens that need portion control and less preparation waste.

For formulation work, test hydration time, flavour strength, salt balance, caking and compatibility with oils or liquids. Tradenest Naturals can share samples and discuss mesh and grade options when a standard powder needs to fit a specific formula.

What determines onion powder price per kg?

The onion powder wholesale price depends on product quality, processing needs, quantity, packaging and delivery terms, not on raw onion cost alone.

Important pricing factors include:

  • Seasonal onion availability and raw material quality.
  • Drying yield, processing losses and energy use.
  • Powder fineness, including 80 mesh or other controlled sizes.
  • Moisture, microbiological, residue or customer-specific testing.
  • Standard bulk packing versus private label or retail packaging.
  • Order volume, repeat schedule and MOQ.
  • Local transport, export handling, port charges, insurance and freight.
  • Incoterm, destination country, payment terms and currency.

So treat a search for dehydrated onion powder price per kg as a starting point. An ex-works or FOB price may look competitive, but the landed cost changes once freight, duties, customs clearance, testing and local delivery are added. Ask suppliers to list which costs are included.

How to request an accurate wholesale quotation

Send one complete buying brief so the onion powder exporter can quote the right product and delivery basis without repeated questions.

Include the following:

  • Product name and intended application.
  • Required mesh, such as 80 mesh, or an acceptable particle size range.
  • Target moisture, microbiological, allergen and residue limits.
  • Quantity for the first order and estimated monthly or annual volume.
  • Pack size, inner liner, pallet preference and private label needs.
  • Destination city, port and country.
  • Preferred Incoterm, such as EXW, FOB, CIF or another agreed basis.
  • Required documents, samples and approval tests.
  • Target delivery date and payment terms.

Ask for quotes in a format you can compare: price per kg, packing cost, testing charges, minimum order, lead time, freight basis, quote validity and payment terms. A professional dehydrated onion powder supplier should also say whether the offer is for a standard stock grade or made-to-order production.
